'''Dembaline''' was a type of [[Pearl/Legends|pearl]]-like [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstone]] that was produced by [[Ocean/Legends|sea]] creatures on<ref name="GCG" /> the [[Waterworld/Legends|waterworld]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Calamari sector/Legends|Calamari sector]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The gemstone's name eventually became a name used among [[Gender/Legends|female]] members of<ref name="GCG" /> Dac's [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="TEA" /> with Mon Calamari [[Musician/Legends|composer]] [[Dembaline]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|182|Dembaline}}</ref>&mdash;who was active by [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref name="Date">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|56|business/13516_4.html|Balmorran Secures Musician Rearmament Contract}}, which mentions [[Dembaline]], is set on the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] "13:5:16," which corresponds to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref>&mdash;being one such individual to share that name.<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dembaline was mentioned in [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]] and [[J.D. Wiker]]'s [[2003]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''.<ref name="GCG" />
